'''Business and economy'''
*At the [[2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference|COP26 Conference]], twenty-four nations and a number of leading car manufacturers, including [[Ford Motor Company|Ford]], [[Mercedes-Benz]] and [[Volvo]], agree to phase out new petrol and diesel cars by [[2030]], and end sale of fossil fuel vehicles by 2040. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/nov/10/cop26-car-firms-agree-to-end-sale-of-fossil-fuel-vehicles-by-2040 (''The Guardian'')]
*[[YouTube dislike hiding]]
**[[YouTube]] removes the public "dislike" count from all YouTube videos, in an attempt to protect content creators from coordinated "dislike attacks". The change was met with near universal opposition. [https://techcrunch.com/2021/11/10/youtube-is-removing-the-dislike-count-on-all-videos-across-its-platform/ (''Tech Crunch'')] [https://www.makeuseof.com/youtube-hiding-dislikes-bad-for-community/ (''Make Use Of'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Germany]]
*****The [[Standing Committee on Vaccination]] recommends that people under the age of 30 should only receive the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] due to a higher risk of heart inflammation with the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna vaccine]] among younger people. [https://www.dw.com/en/covid-germany-recommends-only-biontech-pfizer-shot-to-under-30s/a-59773550 (DW)]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 39,676 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-science-europe-germany-berlin-2cf79b6c58cef88924ad269c707a6b19 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports a record 7,315 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 514,850. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/croatia-logs-highest-daily-new-covid-cases-with-since-pandemic-outbreak-101636559505913.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 1,239 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the national death toll to 250,454. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/russia-s-covid-deaths-hit-new-daily-peak--some-hospitals-run-low-on-oxygen/47099720 (SwissInfo)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] receives a shipment of 896,200 doses of the [[Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.infobae.com/salud/2021/11/10/llegaron-al-pais-casi-900-mil-vacunas-de-pfizer-contra-el-covid-19/ (''Infobae'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
***[[Israel]]'s pandemic advisory board approves the usage of the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years old. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-approves-covid-shots-for-kids-experts-predict-uphill-acceptance-struggle/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] lifts its nationwide nightly curfew from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m., which was implemented in order  to reduce the spread of COVID-19, due to an improved epidemiological situation in the country. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/11/345435/morocco-to-lift-night-curfew-tomorrow (Morocco World News)]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[Japan]] announces that it will cull 143,000 chickens after reporting an outbreak of the "highly pathogenic [[avian influenza]]" at a poultry farm in [[Yokote, Akita|Yokote]], [[Akita Prefecture]]. [https://thehimalayantimes.com/health/japan-reports-first-bird-flu-outbreak-of-season-culling-143000-chickens (''The Himalayan Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Nicaragua–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs a bill into law, targeting sanctions "on the [[Government of Nicaragua|government of Nicaraguan]] [[President of Nicaragua|President]] [[Daniel Ortega]], to restrict multilateral [[bank lending]], and to target [[political corruption|regime corruption]]". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/10/biden-signs-bill-urging-more-sanctions-on-nicaragua-after-vote (Al Jazeera)]
*[[China–United States relations]]
**During the [[2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference|COP26]] conference, [[U.S. Special Presidential Envoy for Climate]] [[John Kerry]] and [[China|Chinese]] climate envoy [[Xie Zhenhua (politician)|Xie Zhenhua]] announce that the [[United States]] and [[China]] have reached an agreement on [[Climate change mitigation|combating climate change]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/10/world/china-us-climate-cop26-joint-agreement-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The lawyer for [[Americans|American]] journalist [[Danny Fenster]] says that [[Myanmar]]'s [[government of Myanmar|authorities]] have [[criminal charge|charged]] him with [[terrorism]] and [[sedition]], in addition to three charges that he had already been facing. Fenster's lawyer says that, under [[counterterrorism]] law, Fenster could face [[life imprisonment]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/10/danny-fenster-myanmar-files-new-charges-against-us-journalist (Al Jazeera)] 
*The [[European Commission]] rejects an appeal from [[Alphabet Inc.]], parent company of [[Google]], regarding a €2.4 [[billion]] ([[USD|$]]2.8 billion) fine charged against the corporation in 2017 for unfairly directing users to its own shopping services. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Business/wireStory/google-loses-appeal-huge-eu-fine-shopping-searches-81080990 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Sweden]]
**[[Prime Minister of Sweden|Swedish Prime Minister]] [[Stefan Löfven]] resigns after seven years in office, although he will continue to remain in office ''ad interim'' until a new government is formed. [[Minister for Finance (Sweden)|Minister for Finance]] [[Magdalena Andersson]], who succeeded Löfven as leader of the [[Swedish Social Democratic Party|Social Democratic Party]] on November 4, is expected to become the first female prime minister in the country's history. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lofven-steps-paving-swedens-1st-female-pm-81080526 (ABC News)]
